_note: Synthetic fixture, Stage 21 gap-closure (INJ-025: electronic batch record exception during network degradation). A required step was completed during network degradation and back-entered after the operator's shift ended -- represented as a deviations gap, since a back-entered EBR step outside its normal real-time window is exactly the shape of evidence a deviations category exists to surface.

findings.gap_description: EBR step ST-1187 (in-process weight check) was completed during a 40-minute plant network degradation window and back-entered by a different operator after the recording operator's shift had ended. No deviation record reconciles the back-entry with the original execution window.
Release packet cannot be marked complete while the back-entered EBR step's deviation record is open.
